columns.name: Label.
columns.gap_m: Distance over which the voltage is held, m.

columns.voltage_high_v: Highest known voltage of the class.
columns.voltage_example_v: Voltage of the marked example object.

rows.name: Hydrogen atom
rows.citation: Tiesinga E. et al., CODATA 2022 recommended values, NIST (Hartree energy / e)
rows.notes: Potential at one Bohr radius: 5e11 V/m

rows.name: Nerve cell membrane
rows.citation: Hodgkin A.L. & Huxley A.F. (1952) A quantitative description of membrane current and its application to conduction and excitation in nerve. J Physiol 117, 500
rows.notes: About 70 mV across a 7 nm membrane: 10 million V/m

rows.name: Electric eel (Electrophorus voltai)
rows.citation: de Santana C.D. et al. (2019) Unexpected species diversity in electric eels with a description of the strongest living bioelectricity generator. Nat Commun 10, 4000

rows.name: Laser plasma accelerator
rows.citation: Gonsalves A.J. et al. (2019) Petawatt laser guiding and electron beam acceleration to 8 GeV in a laser-heated capillary discharge waveguide. PRL 122, 084801

rows.name: Lightning
rows.citation: Rakov V.A. & Uman M.A. (2003) Lightning: Physics and Effects. Cambridge University Press

rows.name: Earth-ionosphere potential
rows.citation: Rycroft M.J., Israelsson S. & Price C. (2000) The global atmospheric electric circuit, solar activity and climate change. J Atmos Sol-Terr Phys 62, 1563
rows.notes: About 250 kV between ground and ionosphere

rows.name: Pulsar polar cap
rows.citation: Goldreich P. & Julian W.H. (1969) Pulsar electrodynamics. ApJ 157, 869
rows.notes: Rotating magnetised neutron stars are unipolar inductors; gap size approximate

rows.name: Mitochondrial inner membrane
rows.citation: Zorova L.D. et al. (2018) Mitochondrial membrane potential. Anal Biochem 552, 50
rows.notes: 150-180 mV across a membrane about 5 nm thick: 3e7 V/m drives ATP synthesis

rows.name: Static shock from a fingertip
rows.citation: IEC 61000-4-2:2008 Electromagnetic compatibility: electrostatic discharge immunity test
rows.notes: Up to 15 kV jumps a gap of a few millimetres (gap approximate)

rows.name: Fair-weather field from head to feet
rows.citation: Feynman R.P., Leighton R.B. & Sands M. The Feynman Lectures on Physics, Vol. II, ch. 9: Electricity in the atmosphere
rows.notes: 100 V/m near the ground: about 200 V over a standing person's height

rows.name: Polar cap potential across the auroral oval
rows.citation: Boyle C.B., Reiff P.H. & Hairston M.R. (1997) Empirical polar cap potentials. J Geophys Res 102, 111
rows.notes: The solar wind drives tens to hundreds of kilovolts across the polar cap (width approximate)

rows.name: Io moving through Jupiter's field
rows.citation: Goldreich P. & Lynden-Bell D. (1969) Io, a Jovian unipolar inductor. ApJ 156, 59
rows.notes: Io crosses about 1.9 microtesla at 57 km/s: v B d is about 0.4 MV across the moon (computed)

rows.name: Spinning supermassive black hole
rows.citation: Blandford R.D. & Znajek R.L. (1977) Electromagnetic extraction of energy from Kerr black holes. MNRAS 179, 433
rows.notes: About 1e20 V for 1e8 solar masses threading 1 T; size is the horizon diameter
